notes: A hand-made crop of the top bar rather than a full screenshot, so the
search bounds have to be given explicitly -- they are normally derived
from the screen height, which this image does not have.
A deliberately awkward case: the image has been rescaled and softened,
and four of the twelve players (slots 4, 7, 8, 11) were dead at the
moment of capture. Deadlock draws a dead player as a flat black
silhouette with a respawn timer over it, which carries no trace of who
they are, so those slots are not listed here at all.
Of the eight living slots, mina (3) and apollo (5) peak at about 0.27
even at their best-fitting box and are not currently read. allow_wrong
covers exactly those two: if a change breaks any of the other six, the
count goes over and this fails.
